image_description: A close-up, angled view of a black loudspeaker enclosure. The image features a large circular woofer with a visible cone and dust cap at the bottom center, and a smaller tweeter covered by a silver mesh grille at the top. To the right, a portion of another driver (likely a mid-range or second woofer) is visible. The enclosure has a glossy black finish with some brushed metal or silver accents on the left edge. Several small circular indentations or mounting points are visible on the baffle.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The brushed metal texture on the left edge appears slightly smeared and lacks the consistent linear grain expected of real brushed aluminum, suggesting minor generative smoothing.

The elliptical shape of the partial driver on the right seems slightly inconsistent with the perspective angle established by the central woofer, appearing slightly 'flatter' than geometric projection would dictate.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of speaker and ensure no misclassification as similar circular objects (e.g., camera lens, fan).
To verify that the circular drivers are perfectly concentric and seamlessly integrated into the baffle without edge bleeding or fusion artifacts.
To ensure the concave/convex geometry of the speaker cones and the depth of the recessed baffle are physically consistent.
To detect subtle noise patterns, sharpening halos, or inconsistent lighting reflections on the glossy surface.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of the mesh grille vs. the cone
Reflection logic on the glossy black surface
Edge sharpness between the silver trim and black body
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'brushed metal' texture on the left; AI often fails to render consistent linear grain in curved perspectives. Also, verify if the mesh pattern on the tweeter remains consistent across the curve or if it warps unnaturally.
